name: aws-tech-blog-writer
description: Publication-ready AWS Tech Blog (Korean) posts about projects, PoCs and customer engagements built on AWS: parallel source digests and a fact base, an approved plan, research and verified architecture diagrams in parallel, a draft written in a fresh context from a minimal packet, fact-check against AWS documentation, a literal-voice style pass (no metaphors, no agentless passives), colour-coded placeholders, delivered as a Word (.docx) file built with docx-js.
